name: Battlestar Overdrive (VST3)
description: A free Windows VST3 overdrive, and a tribute: I wanted to make one for Max Christensen's mad genius solo project Battlestar Overdrive, and Max immediately said it had to be a Battlestar Overdrive. Too good not to bring into existence, so here it is, built with his blessing. Eight drive engines on one knob, running from a polite tube to a fold-crush-chaos cascade with no musical justification whatsoever — a soft tube, a classic soft knee, tape with memory, asymmetric fuzz, tanh into a hard clip, a wavefolder, Chebyshev harmonic injection and total loss — every one of them level-matched by a table the plugin measures for itself at startup, so THRUST changes what it sounds like rather than how loud it is. The CRT is part of the instrument: it names the engine you landed on in blue, speeds its starfield up as you climb the knob, goes to warp on the seventh, blows up a star on the eighth, paints nebulae as SPACE comes up and blooms red when you are genuinely clipping. ANTITHRUST widens the image after the drive and never moves the mono sum. SPACE flies through no less than five overlapping effects, because too much is never enough. It is very good at ruining things, beautifully and thoroughly. Go and listen to the band.
note: Windows VST3 · build 260919.2 · free download · 8 engines · 12-page handbook included.
